{{Quote|I am Lieutenant Zerdran, here at Moff Braynor's request. My field: crisis control.|Zerdran|<ref name="Sensitive Material" />}}
'''Zerdran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at the request of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Braynor]]. He recruited an Imperial hero to eliminate the [[Xesh Squad|Xesh commandos]], an elite [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] unit entrenched in a nearby [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] outpost.
